messages:
sam (new hire): Hi team, just joined today! Monitor arrived but no VESA bracket in the box. Also seeing spotty Wi-Fi near Desk 6.8 (drops after ~3-4 minutes). Anyone I should ping?

ara (it): welcome Sam! :wave: Can you confirm the monitor model and whether the stand is attached? If not, i'll open ticket. Also please note times Wi-Fi dropped so networking can trace.

sam (new hire): Model: LG 34WN80C-B. Stand was in the box but the VESA plate screws were missing. Wi-Fi dropped at ~11:05 and ~11:14 while on slack/video call.

tess (office ops): we keep spare screws/brackets in the supply cabinet. i can drop a VESA plate + screws to Desk 6.8 in ~20m. ara, want me to leave it with reception if sam steps out?

ara (it): thanks. I created ticket IT-2026-4899 for the missing screws and flaky AP. Sam, please attach a photo of the box label to the ticket when you have a sec. Networking-bot, can you look up APs covering 6th floor around 11:05-11:15?

networking-bot: Querying AP logs... Found brief auth failures on AP-6F-03 at 11:05:12 and 11:14:07. Rebooted AP-6F-03 staged for tonight at 02:00 local.

sam (new hire): Photo uploaded. Thanks for the help — appreciate the quick response.

tess (office ops): dropped the bracket and screws at Desk 6.8 at 11:28 and left a sticky note.

ara (it): closing the loop: bracket delivered, ticket IT-2026-4899 updated. AP-6F-03 scheduled for a controlled reboot tonight; re-open ticket if you see drops after that. welcome aboard!
